Reference / runtime/stdio

runtime/stdio#

The native layer under io/stdin, io/stdout: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under io/stdin, io/stdout: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable raw standard-stream boundary. A write reports its accepted prefix; io/stdout turns a short count into IncompleteWrite. No text encoding, newline policy or host-native stream object crosses this ABI.

Public API#

native stdout_write#

native stdout_write(data is @byte) is int

Writes data to standard output; how many bytes went.

native stderr_write#

native stderr_write(data is @byte) is int

Writes data to standard error; how many bytes went.

native stdout_flush#

native stdout_flush() is bool

Writes out what standard output holds back (#132). The runtimes buffer standard output: a terminal gets every line as it ends, a pipe or a file the bytes in blocks; it also goes out before standard error is written, before standard input is read from a terminal, before a child process starts and when the program ends.

native stdin_read#

native stdin_read(limit is int) is @byte

At most limit bytes of standard input; [] at the end.

native stdin_read_line#

native stdin_read_line() is @byte

The next line of standard input, with its newline.
